evals.name: rust-cli-deb-rpm
evals.prompt: I have a Rust CLI tool built with crane that lives in a derivation called `my-tool`. I want to ship .deb and .rpm packages from it so my users on Debian and Fedora can `apt install` / `dnf install` it. I'm the maintainer, my email is sergio@example.com, license is MIT, homepage is https://github.com/sergio/my-tool. Give me the Nix snippet — I want `nix-build -A my-tool-deb` and `nix-build -A my-tool-rpm` to work.
evals.expected_output: A Nix snippet that applies overlay.nix to pkgs (via pkgs.extend or overlays = [...]) to get pkgs.nixBundleApp, then calls bundler.bundle (or bundler.bundleAll) for the deb and rpm formats with maintainer/license/homepage info set, producing attributes named my-tool-deb and my-tool-rpm.

evals.name: release-matrix-install-script
evals.prompt: I have cross-compiled my Go application for x86_64-linux, aarch64-linux, x86_64-darwin, aarch64-darwin, and x86_64-windows. The cross drvs are at `myapp.<system>`. I want to publish a GitHub release where users can do `curl -fsSL https://github.com/foo/myapp/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh` and get the right binary. Version is 1.0.0, MIT licensed. Give me the Nix snippet.
evals.expected_output: A Nix snippet using bundler.release with the matrix attrset covering all five targets, including portable tar.gz/zip formats plus optional native installers, with releaseUrl set to the GitHub releases download URL using ${VERSION} (literal) and installScripts = true (or default).

evals.name: gui-app-appimage-with-desktop
evals.prompt: I'm packaging a GUI image viewer called `pixview` built from a Tauri app (derivation `pixview`). I want a single-file Linux distribution — an AppImage. It should show up in the application launcher as 'Pixview' under the Graphics category, with an icon I have at `./assets/pixview.png`, and register as the default handler for `image/png` and `image/jpeg`. Give me the Nix snippet.
evals.expected_output: A Nix snippet calling bundler.bundle with format = "appimage", setting info.desktopEntries with name, exec, categories=["Graphics"], icon, iconPath pointing to the PNG, and mimeTypes for PNG/JPEG.

evals.name: signed-msi-with-service
evals.prompt: I need to ship a Windows MSI of my sync agent. The drv (cross-compiled with mingwW64) is at `pkgs.pkgsCross.mingwW64.sync-agent`. I want it to install a Windows service that runs the agent on boot (auto-start), and the MSI needs to be Authenticode-signed with my cert at `./certs/auth.pfx`. The cert password will come from an env var. Also, I plan to ship updates so the UpgradeCode must be stable. Give me the Nix snippet plus the command I'll run to sign.
evals.expected_output: Nix snippet calling bundler.bundle with format = "msi", target = { arch = "x86_64"; os = "windows"; }, an info.services entry with restart/exec for the agent, info.msiUpgradeCode pinned to a UUID, info.signing.windows.enable = true with pkcs12File pointing at the cert and timestampUrl set. Plus an explanation that signing runs after building the bundle via P12_PASSWORD=... ./result/sign.sh, or one-shot via bundler.signedApp (nix-build -A <name>-signed then run the resulting ./result/bin/<name>-sign).
